cause_quote: The Solid port replaced the Lit template `html`${t("agents.skillsPanel.subtitle")}\n        ${...}`` (whose newline renders as a space) with JSX `{t("agents.skillsPanel.subtitle")}` followed by the value on the next line, which JSX joins with no space.
user_saw: Settings pages showed run-together text such as "permissions.65/65 enabled.", "Session:agent:main:main" and "UI budget.Telegram probe timed out".
summary: Added explicit spaces between a sentence and the following value at six Control UI JSX sites (Agents skills/tools/preview, channels partial-snapshot notice, plugin consent, session storage error).
reasoning: The removed lines blame to the Lit-to-Solid ports of October 2026; I checked the pre-port Lit file at 30469f45^ and the subtitle and value sat on separate lines of an html template literal, so whitespace rendered, and the JSX port dropped it. Several sibling ports (f49b7cd0 channels #168811, 8304c4b6 plugins #168758, b8d31e96/b86675c7 config) caused the other sites the same way; I name the Agents port as the cause since it owns the agent-tool/skills sites in the headline examples, hence medium confidence.
